en.name: Silverius
en.summary: A pope deposed and exiled by the Byzantine general Belisarius at the instigation of the empress Theodora, dying shortly after in exile.
en.body: Silverius, son of Pope Hormisdas, became pope amid the Gothic War as Belisarius's Byzantine forces retook Rome. He was accused, likely falsely, of conspiring with the Goths and was forcibly deposed and exiled by Belisarius under pressure from the empress Theodora, who favored the more pliable deacon Vigilius as a replacement. Silverius died in exile on the island of Palmarola, and is venerated as a martyr.
